search_protocol.question: What external reporting standards, data-integration resources, scientific-evidence benchmarks, OOD evaluation practices, reproducibility requirements, protein-corona comparators, and preregistration precedents constrain the R2 manuscript portfolio?
inclusion: authoritative standard, policy, or peer-reviewed work with a stable publisher, archive, or proceedings record
direct relevance to at least one R2 manuscript scope or operational glossary term
verified title, year, landing URL, and DOI where a DOI exists
exclusion: sources used solely as an empirical substitute for the missing T123 compatible target or T124 protected-data evaluation
sources that justify a causal, generalisation, or replication claim beyond their study design
search_protocol.limitation: This is a targeted related-work and comparator packet, not a systematic review or a substitute for the real-data and independent-evaluator gates.

references.citation: Monopoli, M. P., ?berg, C., Salvati, A., & Dawson, K. A. (2012). Biomolecular coronas provide the biological identity of nanosized materials. Nature Nanotechnology, 7, 779?786.
references.title: Biomolecular coronas provide the biological identity of nanosized materials
references.use_boundary: Context for the biological significance of coronas; it does not validate any BioInterfaceOS result.

references.citation: Faria, M., Bj?rnmalm, M., Thurecht, K. J., et al. (2018). Minimum information reporting in bio?nano experimental literature. Nature Nanotechnology, 13, 777?785.
references.title: Minimum information reporting in bio?nano experimental literature
references.use_boundary: Defines a comparator for required metadata; it does not make incompletely reported studies comparable.

references.citation: Chetwynd, A. J., Wheeler, K. E., & Lynch, I. (2019). Best practice in reporting corona studies: Minimum information about Nanomaterial Biocorona Experiments (MINBE). Nano Today, 28, 100758.
references.title: Best practice in reporting corona studies: Minimum information about Nanomaterial Biocorona Experiments (MINBE)
references.use_boundary: Provides a corona-specific reporting checklist; it does not establish protein-corona measurements in R2.

references.citation: Wilkinson, M. D., Dumontier, M., Aalbersberg, I. J. J., et al. (2016). The FAIR Guiding Principles for scientific data management and stewardship. Scientific Data, 3, 160018.
references.title: The FAIR Guiding Principles for scientific data management and stewardship
references.use_boundary: Guides findability and reuse; FAIR metadata alone does not prove scientific validity.

references.citation: Hastings, J., Jeliazkova, N., Owen, G., et al. (2015). eNanoMapper: Harnessing ontologies to enable data integration for nanomaterial risk assessment. Journal of Biomedical Semantics, 6, 10.
references.title: eNanoMapper: Harnessing ontologies to enable data integration for nanomaterial risk assessment
references.use_boundary: Supports controlled vocabulary design; ontology alignment is not a causal model.

references.citation: Wadden, D., Lin, S., Lo, K., et al. (2020). Fact or Fiction: Verifying Scientific Claims. In EMNLP 2020, 7534?7550.
references.title: Fact or Fiction: Verifying Scientific Claims
references.use_boundary: A comparator for claim/evidence evaluation design; source-cell location is not claim truth verification.

references.citation: Koh, P. W., Sagawa, S., Marklund, H., et al. (2021). WILDS: A Benchmark of in-the-Wild Distribution Shifts. ICML 2021, PMLR 139, 5637?5664.
references.title: WILDS: A Benchmark of in-the-Wild Distribution Shifts
references.use_boundary: Motivates declared group shifts and separate OOD reporting; it does not make a one-study-per-endpoint collection an OOD benchmark.

references.citation: Heil, B. J., Hoffman, M. M., Markowetz, F., et al. (2021). Reproducibility standards for machine learning in the life sciences. Nature Methods, 18, 1132?1135.
references.title: Reproducibility standards for machine learning in the life sciences
references.use_boundary: Supports software and workflow reproducibility requirements; it does not constitute independent scientific reproduction.

references.citation: Findlay, M. R., Freitas, D. N., Mobed-Miremadi, M., & Wheeler, K. E. (2018). Machine learning provides predictive analysis into silver nanoparticle protein corona formation from physicochemical properties. Environmental Science: Nano, 5, 64?71.
references.title: Machine learning provides predictive analysis into silver nanoparticle protein corona formation from physicochemical properties
references.use_boundary: A domain comparator with its own silver-ENM and protein-corona scope; it is not a benchmark result for BioInterfaceOS.

references.citation: Ban, Z., Yuan, P., Yu, F., et al. (2020). Machine learning predicts the functional composition of the protein corona and the cellular recognition of nanoparticles. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, 117, 10492?10499.
references.title: Machine learning predicts the functional composition of the protein corona and the cellular recognition of nanoparticles
references.use_boundary: A comparator for stated target and split design; its results must not be imported as BioInterfaceOS evidence.

references.citation: Canchola, A., Li, K., Chen, K., et al. (2025). Meta-Analysis and Machine Learning Prediction of Protein Corona Composition across Nanoparticle Systems in Biological Media. ACS Nano, 19, 37633?37650.
references.title: Meta-Analysis and Machine Learning Prediction of Protein Corona Composition across Nanoparticle Systems in Biological Media
references.use_boundary: A scale and curation comparator; its database cannot be silently treated as a validated R2 training or external test set.

references.citation: Nosek, B. A., & Lakens, D. (2014). Registered Reports: A Method to Increase the Credibility of Published Results. Social Psychology, 45, 137?141.
references.title: Registered Reports: A Method to Increase the Credibility of Published Results
references.use_boundary: Supports Paper C's protocol-only route until T124; it does not convert a pre-lock candidate into a confirmed result.
